{{Short description|French islamicist}}

'''Ghaleb Bencheikh''' ({{Langx|ar|غالب بن الشيخ}}; born 1960 in [[Jeddah]], [[Saudi Arabia]]) is a [[Doctor of Science]] and [[physics]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.voir.ca/publishing/article.aspx?zone=1&section=11&article=42380 |title=Intercultural Dialogue |author=Mathilde Singer |publisher=View Montreal |accessdate=July 28, 2009 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100905100912/http://www.voir.ca/publishing/article.aspx?zone=1 |archivedate=September 5, 2010 }}</ref><ref>[http://www.elmoudjahid.com/accueil/Nation/39774.html Interview with Ghaleb Bencheikh]</ref>

Son of [[Sheikh Abbas]] Bencheikh El Hocine and brother of [[Soheib Bencheikh]], Ghaleb Bencheikh is the President of the "Foundation of Islam in France". He hosts the TV show "Islam" which is related to [[Philosopher|philosophical training]] and [[theology]].

Ghaleb Bencheikh chairs the [[World Conference of Religions for Peace]], which leads to many interventions in [[France]] and abroad. Speaking with ease, Ghaleb Bencheikh spread and popularize his way theses and strong ideas of his brother [[Soheib Bencheikh]].

Ghaleb Bencheikh is a member of the sponsoring committee of the French Coalition for the Decade, spreading culture of [[peace]] and non-violence.
